parameters.name: consumerGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the consumer group for which you want to delete subscriptions.

parameters.name: filterType
parameters.description:
The type of the filter expression. Valid values:

*   SQL: filters messages by using SQL expressions.
*   TAG: filters messages by using tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rocketmq delete-consumer-group-subscription --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --consumer-group-id CID-TEST --topic-name topic_test --filter-type TAG --filter-expression 0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rocketmq DELETE /instances/rmq-cn-7e22ody0000/consumerGroups/CID-TEST/subscriptions --region cn-hangzhou --filterExpression 0 --topicName topic_test --filterType TAG --header "Content-Type=application/json"
